1971 continues to guide India, Bangladesh relations
2023-05-31T01:57:54+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/diplomacy/news/1971-continues-guide-india-bangladesh-relations-3333931

The 1971 Liberation War continues to guide the bilateral relations between Dhaka and Delhi, said Indian High Commissioner Pranay Verma yesterday.

He made the comment while inauguration a Liberation War Gallery at the Indian House in the capital's Gulshan.

At the programme, Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan mentioned India as true friend of Bangladesh and highlighted the bilateral relations between the two countries.

"It was proven in 1971 when they [India] stood by us in our difficult times," he said.

Indian high commissioner said the gallery would serve as the "sombre remembrance" of the sacrifices people of the two countries made in the war.

Artifacts, photographs, and documents related to the Liberation War got place at the gallery.

The gallery will "highlight our shared commitment to preserve and celebrate the spirit of 1971," the high commissioner said.

He said the gallery will be a "new bridge between our past and the future."
